scope: One corrected measurement-only activation diagnostic; no preparation rerun, training, optimizer, endpoint compression, allocation search or successor
state: exact final learned FP32 factors and explicit saved signs authenticated from source-pair inventory; no optimizer or last-soft reconstruction
backend: native eager, no cache; original small dynamics tensor dtypes retained
prepared_data_policy: exact copied v1 source, consumed IDs/masks, accepted order and all original generation receipts; no regeneration, substitution or new input tokenization
capture_projection: elapsed since v2 supervisor start +1.25*sum(14*max(first two capture times per window))+300 <= actual v2 deadline; v1 debit remains separately charged once
selector: unchanged fixed 12-of-16 engineering selector, gap RMS >=0.5 total error RMS above measured noise; null/indeterminate handling unchanged
template_correction: authenticate raw asset size/hash; strict UTF8; only CRLF-to-LF conversion; reject bare CR and all other changes; exact canonical hash and same17 CPU prompt/probe tokenizations before model load
scientific_source_policy: all frozen v1 checkout files and measurement helper unchanged; only driver guard, reuse provenance, cumulative timing, necessary path wiring and tests may differ
failure_action: stop without retry; after process exits, separately time CPU-only failure accounting, complete preservation verification and failure seal
stop_after: single measurement result and report for review; no automatic escalation or cross-chat contact
